{"consolidated_memory":"## storage/blob/uploader.rs - Partial Upload Issues (Four Separate Incidents)

All incidents involved the same symptom (final part never acknowledged) in the same file (storage/blob/uploader.rs) but had distinct triggers and root causes:

### Incident 1: [2026-02-26] OAuth Provider Sessions
- **Trigger**: Only sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- **Problem**: Partial upload in the uploader
- **Signal**: Final part never acknowledged
- **Root cause**: Config loader reading wrong environment file
- **Fix**: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- **PR #1085**, branch fix/partial-upload-1
- **Repro**: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- **Stack**: Rust; covering check in storage/blob/uploader.rs module test block
- **Result**: Error rate dropped from 9.4% to under 2 per 10,000

### Incident 2: [2026-04-12] Empty Input List
- **Trigger**: Only when input list came in empty
- **Problem**: Partial upload in the uploader
- **Signal**: Final part never acknowledged
- **Root cause**: Schema drift between migration and model
- **Fix**: Regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- **PR #8051**, branch fix/partial-upload-2
- **Repro**: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- **Stack**: Rust; covering check in storage/blob/uploader.rs module test block
- **Result**: 70 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

### Incident 3: [2026-07-13] Five Percent Rollout Bucket
- **Trigger**: Only for accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- **Problem**: Partial upload in the uploader
- **Signal**: Final part never acknowledged
- **Root cause**: Listener registered but never removed
- **Fix**: Removed listener on teardown and asserted it in test
- **PR #8352**, branch fix/partial-upload-3
- **Repro**: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- **Stack**: Rust; covering check in storage/blob/uploader.rs module test block
- **Result**: Job finished in 54 minutes instead of 1 hour

### Incident 4: [2026-07-20] Request Race Condition
- **Trigger**: Only when two requests raced on same key
- **Problem**: Partial upload in the uploader
- **Signal**: Final part never acknowledged
- **Root cause**: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- **Fix**: Invalidated cache entry inside write transaction
- **PR #9697**, branch fix/partial-upload-4
- **Repro**: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- **Stack**: Rust; covering check in storage/blob/uploader.rs module test block
- **Result**: Reclaimed 21 GB of blob storage"}
